source_window.dataset: National Heritage List for England (NHLE) - Listed Building polygons, FeatureServer layer 3

first_missing_criterion: Retrievable record-level official/public Historic England NHLE Listed Building polygon feature payload for the selected Exeter centroid attribute window, with at least one returned feature containing physical Polygon/MultiPolygon coordinates and record-bound ListEntry, Name and Grade/type-use evidence. The official layer schema confirms esriGeometryPolygon geometry, GeoJSON support and the ListEntry/Name/Grade/area_ha/NGR/Easting/Northing fields, but the distinct first-50 centroid-filter query payload was not retrievable through the available retrieval channel before any feature or polygon coordinates could be read; therefore no individual building record was accepted.
